description:
Communities competing for Seedit's /s/gaming route. The highest-rated finalized candidate resolves the route. Subscriptions and post links continue to use exact community addresses.

https://github.com/bitsocialnet/lists/blob/master/seedit-directories/seedit-gaming-directory.json
rules: Posts must be directly about games or gaming; a forced caption or generic meme template is not enough.
Reply to an existing discussion instead of making response posts, bandwagons, raids, or ragebait.
Do not request, enable, or link to piracy.
Mark spoilers and NSFW content clearly, and never put spoilers in the title.
No giveaways, trades, sales, donation requests, referral links, or other promotional schemes.
Link the original source and avoid URL shorteners, rehosts, and website screenshots.
Keep self-promotion limited and do not post surveys, livestream promotion, affiliate spam, or AI-generated filler.
Post open-ended gaming discussions as text posts.
No bigotry, threats, harassment, or toxic personal attacks.
